name: Live on Time - The Engineered Sky

captions.speaker: NATORI
captions.text:
History didn't evolve.
It was switched on.

captions.speaker: ROGUE
captions.text: Nemesis. Day zero of the cage.

captions.speaker: NATORI
captions.text:
Six hundred years,
and Earth is captured,

captions.speaker: ROGUE
captions.text: locked to a sun that isn't ours.

captions.speaker: NATORI
captions.text:
They hung the Moon
like a camera.

captions.speaker: ROGUE
captions.text: An eye for the inmates below.

captions.speaker: NATORI
captions.text:
Now the engineers
walk among us.

captions.speaker: ROGUE
captions.text: And the day-count begins. Tick.

captions.speaker: NATORI
captions.text:
Every stone is
a line of code.

captions.speaker: ROGUE
captions.text: Compliance, carved in granite.

captions.speaker: NATORI
captions.text:
The flood wasn't wrath.
It was maintenance.

captions.speaker: ROGUE
captions.text: Cache cleared. Survivors rebooted.

captions.speaker: NATORI
captions.text:
They woke
remembering nothing.

captions.speaker: ROGUE
captions.text: Amnesia is the default state.

captions.speaker: NATORI
captions.text:
They built a clock
out of a mountain.

captions.speaker: ROGUE
captions.text: To time the thing that burns.

captions.speaker: NATORI
captions.text:
Rectilinear. Exact.
One hundred thirty-eight.

captions.speaker: ROGUE
captions.text: The number that keeps returning.

captions.speaker: NATORI
captions.text:
The Phoenix runs
every 138 years.

captions.speaker: ROGUE
captions.text: The clock already knows your name.

captions.speaker: NATORI
captions.text:
Six hundred and 138,
interlocking,

captions.speaker: ROGUE
captions.text: two algorithms, one countdown.

captions.speaker: NATORI
captions.text:
The last six-hundred-year
gear closed in 1962.

captions.speaker: ROGUE
captions.text: The last turn before ours.

captions.speaker: NATORI
captions.text:
The dials are stacking
on our decade.

captions.speaker: ROGUE
captions.text: We are standing on the node.

captions.speaker: NATORI
captions.text:
Nineteen beats
to the next interface.

captions.speaker: ROGUE
captions.text: Count them. Out loud.

captions.speaker: NATORI
captions.text:
May 2040. The sun darkens.
The crust slips.

captions.speaker: ROGUE
captions.text: The oceans leave their basins.

captions.speaker: NATORI
captions.text:
Then Nemesis X,
for whatever's left.

captions.speaker: ROGUE
captions.text: The cull is a separate protocol.

captions.speaker: NATORI
captions.text:
The endpoint isn't a fear.
It's a figure.

captions.speaker: ROGUE
captions.text: Fixed. Scheduled. Patient.

captions.speaker: NATORI
captions.text:
2178. The containment
finally fails.

captions.speaker: ROGUE
captions.text: The cage opens. Same as it closed.

captions.speaker: NATORI
captions.text:
5239. 2178.
Read the same, returning.

captions.speaker: ROGUE
captions.text: Live on time. Emit no evil.
